name: St. Moritz and the Engadin
tagline: A high sunny valley of blue lakes and larch forest, home to the ultimate glamour resort and the greatest scenic railways in the world.

intro: The Engadin is the high valley of the Inn river in the south-east canton of Graubünden, running at about 1,800 metres above sea level between wide peaks. It is a place of large skies, blue-green lakes, larch woods and low stone villages with sgraffito-decorated houses, where Romansh, Switzerland's fourth language, is still spoken. St. Moritz, the valley's resort, claims 322 days of sunshine a year, and is where winter tourism began in 1864.

St. Moritz has a reputation for glamour, with luxury hotels, polo on snow, horse races on the frozen lake and the Cresta Run, but the surrounding valley is just as good for ordinary visitors. Lake Sils and Lake Silvaplana are two of the most beautiful Alpine lakes, paths climb through larches to hut restaurants, and quiet villages such as Sils Maria, where Nietzsche wrote, and Pontresina offer a calmer stay.

The Engadin is also the heart of the scenic railways of Graubünden. The Bernina Express crosses the Bernina Pass from the Engadin to Italy, and the Albula and Bernina lines, with their curved viaducts and spirals, are UNESCO World Heritage Sites. The Glacier Express, slowest of the fast trains, crosses the Landwasser Viaduct and runs to Zermatt. Three days is a good time to enjoy the valley.

whyVisit.intro: The Engadin combines sunshine, lakes and the most famous railways in Europe.

image.alt: Lake St. Moritz with the resort town on its hillside

attractions.text: A lake ringed by hotels and pines, which freezes in winter for horse racing and other events.

attractions.name: Landwasser Viaduct

image.file: File:RhB Ge 4-4 II 614 Glacier Express on Landwasser Viaduct.jpg
image.alt: The red Glacier Express crossing the curved Landwasser Viaduct

attractions.text: A curved, six-arch stone viaduct 65 metres high, opened in 1904, on the UNESCO-listed Albula line.
attractions.tip: Photograph it from the viewpoint at Filisur.

attractions.name: Brusio spiral viaduct

image.alt: The Brusio spiral viaduct curving through green fields

attractions.text: A circular viaduct on the Bernina line, where the train loops around to lose height on the way to Italy.

attractions.text: A high pass at 2,253 metres, with a pale lake beside the railway and views of glaciers.
attractions.tip: Ride in the window seat on the right.
